newsitem.title: MOROCCO: UAE businessmen look to joint Moroccan venture.
newsitem.headline: UAE businessmen look to joint Moroccan venture.

text.p: A group of businessmen from the United Arab Emirates is looking at setting up a joint trading and investment company with Moroccan entrepreneurs, the official Moroccan news agency MAP said on Tuesday.
The UAE group visited Morocco's main financial centre Casablanca on Monday and met Trade Minister Driss Jettou, the agency said.
It quoted Abdellah Lamhirbi, of the UAE delegation, as saying the two sides wanted to give priority to the company taking part in joint projects, particularly in farming and the food industry.
